user_reported_bug: Login page rechaza documento (cédula) forzando formato de correo electrónico. Ejemplo: cuando el docente Andrés Causil intenta ingresar con cédula 1128441439, aparece error del navegador 'Incluye @ en la dirección de correo electrónico. En 1128441439 falta un símbolo @.' Además el label sigue diciendo 'CORREO INSTITUCIONAL'. Usuario reporta también que los cambios no se guardan y siente que gasta créditos sin resultado.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the exact login-by-cédula bug end to end: API accepts document and email login, fresh /login UI shows USUARIO (not CORREO INSTITUCIONAL), input is type=text with no HTML5 email validation, and Andrés logs in with cédula 1128441439 to /change-password without invalid-credentials/email-validation messages. No affected auth API or login flow is failing. Non-blocking observation: raw /login HTML does not contain the requested meta http-equiv cache tags, but the HTTP response header is no-store/no-cache/must-revalidate.

The HTTP response header does include cache-control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, so the user-visible stale-login symptom did not reproduce.

rca_of_the_issue: The prior user-visible failure likely came from the frontend still using/serving an email-type login field or cached old UI. Current deployed React UI uses a text input and shows Usuario, and backend accepts numeric cédula. A residual deployment/public-index mismatch exists for meta tags/title, but the HTTP response already disables caching and the login bug no longer reproduces.
